comment: Communities/districts along the Airport Run route (Norman Manley → Ocho Rios). Each entry triggers a community sign (recognition layer 2) when the car enters the radius. needs_owner_review:true = approximate position from map data; owner's lived knowledge is authoritative.

communities.name: Palisadoes
communities.note: Narrow strip of land — sea on both sides. Coconut trees line the road; Gun Boat Beach to the left.

communities.name: Harbour View
communities.note: Harbour View roundabout — where the Palisadoes meets the mainland. Potholes begin just past here.

communities.name: Kingston
communities.note: Capital city — the pulse of Jamaica.

communities.name: Mountain View
communities.note: Mountain View community along the avenue of the same name.

communities.name: Half Way Tree
communities.note: Uptown hub — Half Way Tree clock tower is the meeting point.

communities.name: New Kingston
communities.note: Business district of Kingston — towers and traffic.

communities.name: Constant Spring
communities.note: Uptown Kingston — Usain Bolt's Tracks & Records restaurant is on this road.

communities.name: Spanish Town
communities.note: Jamaica's former colonial capital — historic square and iron bridge.

communities.name: Bog Walk
communities.note: Village at the entrance to the Bog Walk Gorge — Rio Cobre river runs alongside.

communities.name: Flat Bridge
communities.note: Narrow bridge over the Rio Cobre — one of Jamaica's most photographed road crossings.

communities.name: Linstead
communities.note: Market town famous for the folk song 'Linstead Market'.

communities.name: Ewarton
communities.note: Small town on the road to Moneague.

communities.name: Moneague
communities.note: Mountain crossroads town — goats own these roads.

communities.name: Faith's Pen
communities.note: Famous roadside cookshops — jerk chicken, roast yam, festival. Pull over.

communities.name: Claremont
communities.note: Small town on the approach to Fern Gully.

communities.name: Fern Gully
communities.note: The famous gully — a cathedral of bamboo and fern overhead.

communities.name: Ocho Rios
communities.note: Jamaica's north coast resort town — Dunn's River Falls at the end of the road.
